title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, continued from the previous page. X is a (topological or orbifold) space with a normal-crossings divisor Θ; the case in view is the Deligne–Mumford compactification of M_{g,ν} with its boundary divisor. Θ gives the multiplicity filtration X = Θ^(0) ⊃ Θ^(1) = Θ ⊃ Θ^(2) ⊃ ... (2.44). D_d denotes a 'topological normalization' of Θ^(d): points of Θ^(d) together with a choice of d local branches. More generally, D_{d_0,...,d_r} is the space of points with a flag of branch subsets of cardinalities d_0 ≥ d_1 ≥ ... ≥ d_r. For a 'stratum' D mapping to X:
- V_{D,X} is a tubular neighbourhood of D in X;
- V^*_{D,X} is the deleted neighbourhood V_{D,X} ∩ (X∖Θ).

What this page does.
1. Diagram (2.45). It sets up a semi-simplicial ('1/2-simplicial') system indexed by chains d_0 ≥ ... ≥ d_r:
   V^*_{d_0...d_r} := V^*_{D_{d_0...d_r},X} ↪ V_{d_0...d_r} ← D_{d_0...d_r}.
2. Maps. All the V^* map to V^*_0 = X^* = D_0^* = X∖Θ. Those with d_r > 0 map into V^*_{Θ,X}, the deleted tubular neighbourhood of the whole divisor. Grothendieck writes V^*_{Θ,X} = X^{*∞} = D_0^{*∞}, the 'structure at infinity' of X^*. It is the homotopy type of the boundary of the real oriented blow-up (Harvey/Borel–Serre type bordification).
3. 'Théorème de recollement'. Let V^*_S be the semi-simplicial topos formed by the V^*_{d_0...d_r} with d_r > 0. There is a natural morphism from the inductive limit (descent/gluing) of this semi-simplicial topos to V^*_{Θ,X}, and it is an equivalence of topoi. A fortiori it is a homotopy equivalence: the π_0 correspond and the π_1 at corresponding base points correspond.

In modern terms, the link at infinity of a normal-crossings compactification is glued (as a homotopy colimit, indeed by étale-type descent of topoi) from the punctured tubular neighbourhoods of the strata. Each of these is, up to homotopy, a (S^1)^d-bundle over the corresponding open stratum.

Purpose. The next page derives two corollaries:
- Cor. 1 applies the same statement inductively to each stratum D_δ with its induced divisor Θ_δ.
- Cor. 2 (crossed out): if X^{*∞} → X^* is suitably connected (iso on π_0 and π_1), then the fundamental groupoid of X^* = M_{g,ν} is the colimit of the groupoids Π̃_{d_0}, Π̃_{d_0 d_1}, ... of low-codimension pieces at infinity.

This is the route to the 'structure at infinity' and to the two-level principle of the Esquisse d'un programme.
errors: Indexing inconsistency. Here the chains are written with non-strict inequalities d_0 ≥ d_1 ≥ ... ≥ d_r, while the object is called semi-simplicial. With repetitions allowed one gets degenerate simplices, i.e. a simplicial rather than semi-simplicial object. The next page uses strict chains δ_0 > δ_1 > ... > δ_s, which is the correct nerve-of-poset indexing for a semi-simplicial descent statement.

The statement depends on the 'topological normalization' D_d and on compatible systems of tubular neighbourhoods (control data). The previous page flags both as requiring delicate normal-crossing hypotheses, still 'à préciser'. As stated, 'equivalence of topoi' rather than mere homotopy equivalence needs the maps V^*_{d_0..d_r} → V^*_{Θ,X} to be étale-like and the system to be a genuine (hyper)cover; this is not checked.

ideas.what: Multiplicity filtration of a normal-crossings divisor and the flag strata D_{d_0...d_r} (normalized strata with nested branch choices)
ideas.modern_name: stratification by intersections of branches / normalization of strata of an snc or nc divisor (cf. Deligne's weight spectral sequence)

ideas.what: Gluing theorem: the deleted tubular neighbourhood of Θ (structure at infinity X^{*∞}) is the inductive limit of the semi-simplicial topos of deleted neighbourhoods of flag strata, giving an equivalence of topoi and hence of homotopy types
ideas.modern_name: homotopy-colimit / descent decomposition of the link (boundary of the real oriented blow-up) of a normal-crossings compactification
ideas.usually_credited_to: folklore; Durfee (neighbourhoods of algebraic sets, 1983); for moduli: Harvey bordification, Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura, Boggi
ideas.where_published: Only the idea of the 'structure à l'infini' and the gluing of the Teichmüller tower appears in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), without this formulation

ideas.what: X^{*∞} := V^*_{Θ,X} as the 'structure at infinity' of the open variety X^* = X∖Θ
ideas.modern_name: homotopy type at infinity / boundary of the Harvey or Borel–Serre bordification
ideas.usually_credited_to: Harvey (1979), Borel–Serre (1973) in the arithmetic-group setting
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme ('structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν})

missed.claim: Grothendieck formulates the decomposition of the link at infinity of a normal-crossings compactification topos-theoretically: an equivalence of topoi between V^*_{Θ,X} and the inductive limit of a semi-simplicial topos of punctured neighbourhoods of flag strata. He leaves the defining hypotheses (topological normalization, tubular neighbourhoods) open. The topos-level statement, stronger than a homotopy-colimit statement and applicable to orbifold/stack strata, does not appear to be stated in this form in the literature on moduli of curves.
missed.quote: on a un morphisme de limite ind[uctive] de ce topos dans V^*_{Θ,X} = X^{*∞} = D_0^{*∞}, et c'est là une équivalence de topos (a fortiori, c'est une équivalence d'homotopie
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It is a clean descent formulation for the boundary of stacky normal-crossings compactifications, e.g. for profinite or étale homotopy at infinity of \bar M_{g,n}. It is relevant to the Grothendieck–Teichmüller action on tangential base points, where the literature works with groupoids rather than topoi.

deep.surprise_reason: The underlying homotopy decomposition is folklore, and its use for M_{g,ν} anticipates published work by Hatcher–Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura and Boggi. The explicit topos-equivalence formulation with flag strata is a notable unpublished detail behind the Esquisse's 'structure à l'infini', but not a new theorem.
transcription_corrections: Margin note: likely '0 ≤ r ≤ ..., d_0 ≥ d_1 ≥ ... ≥ d_r ≥ 0' (indexing range of the system).
's'envoient tous [le, dans] V^*_0 = X^*' reads as 's'envoient tous dans V^*_0 = X^*', with the inserted remark 'X^* = D_0^* = X∖Θ'.
The crossed-out phrase 'sauf via V^*_d → D' should be 'sauf ceux via ...' (deleted anyway).
'topos 1/2 simpliciaux au dessus de V^*_{Θ,X}' means semi-simplicial topos over V^*_{Θ,X}; '[?] plats [?]' may be 'dont les composantes sont ... plats' (flat/étale components).
Last lines: probably '... se réduit à une bijection sur les π_0, et [des isomorphismes sur] les π_1 relatifs à des points base qui se correspondent'.
